data.narrative:
StoreDot is a Series E frontier-tech company in the Climate & Energy sector, having raised $206.5M to date. The comparable universe comprises 9 peers across the sector—1 public (LNZA) and 8 private companies including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. Given the absence of same-stage or adjacent-stage peers meeting minimum density thresholds (fewer than 3 datapoints in filtered cohorts), peer-median valuation was not applicable.

The analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 1.4x step-up multiplier typical of Series E-to-next-stage transitions to the $206.5M total-raised proxy. This yields a median implied valuation of $289M. The triangulated range, incorporating downside and upside sensitivities around this single method, spans $246M (low) to $332M (high).

The $289M median represents a conservative positioning given limited comparable data. Key uncertainties include the absence of tight peer valuation anchors at StoreDot's stage and the company's position within a broad sector cohort rather than a narrowly defined subsegment. Any revision would require either additional same-stage comparable transactions or material new information regarding StoreDot's revenue trajectory and capital requirements through profitability.
